title: Delivery Failure and Redelivery Rate
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=delivery:parcel
| stats count as parcels, sum(eval(if(attempt_status="failed",1,0))) as failed, sum(eval(if(redelivery_needed="true",1,0))) as redeliveries by carrier
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed/parcels,1), redelivery_pct=round(100*redeliveries/parcels,1)
| sort - failure_pct
description: Shows which delivery workflows most often turn into failed attempts or redelivery hassle.
value: The hidden cost of a parcel is often your time and coordination, not only the shipping price.
implementation: Capture delivery attempt outcomes in `index=personal`; compare failure and redelivery rates by carrier.
visualization: Carrier table of parcel count, failure percentage, and redelivery percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which deliveries keep failing on the first attempt and turning into avoidable extra hassle.
